title: dedicated: improve autoscaling burst controls, throughput guarantees, and utilization reporting
author: Priya Shah
description: Motivation: Dedicated customers need predictable throughput guarantees while still allowing short-term burst capacity for traffic spikes. Existing autoscaler supports target-based scaling but lacks: 1) a separate short-term burst budget that can be consumed without affecting sustained throughput SLOs; 2) explicit throughput reservation knobs for SLAs; and 3) accurate fleet-level utilization metrics that reflect both sustained and burst consumption. This PR introduces: - Burst allowance: a configurable burst_budget and decay window that lets the autoscaler allocate temporary capacity for short spikes. - Throughput reservation: a reserve_throughput field (tokens/sec per pool) that the scheduler treats as guaranteed capacity. - Utilization reporting: new metrics exported to the observability pipeline (fleet_utilization_pct, sustained_utilization_pct, burst_consumed_tokens, burst_remaining_tokens, sustained_throughput_rps) and corresponding Console panels and dashboard tiles. - Backwards-compatible config schema v2 for dedicated pools; old configs are migrated on load with warnings. - Tests and end-to-end perf canary to validate scaling behavior under spike patterns. Checklist: - [x] Design doc and Linear tickets referenced (ENG-4234, ENG-4310) - [x] Implementation of burst budget and reservation logic - [x] Unit and integration tests for edge cases (negative budgets, rollover) - [x] Observability export contract and Console panels - [x] Migration path and deprecation warnings - [x] Docs: operational runbook and config examples Rollout plan: Feature gated under dedicated.autoscale.v2; enable for internal staging + canary customers for 2 weeks, then gradual opt-in for paying Dedicated customers. Impact: should reduce incident rate due to temporary capacity starvation during bursty traffic and provide SREs with clearer utilization signals for capacity planning.
commits:
1) Add burst budget and decay window to autoscaler (autscaler/burst_budget implementation)
2) Add reserve_throughput field and scheduler enforcement
3) Export fleet-level utilization metrics and telemetry hooks
4) Console: new dedicated autoscale dashboard panels
5) Config schema v2 and migration loader with deprecation warnings
6) Tests: unit, integration, canary harness updates
7) Docs: operational runbook and examples
